question: Kakinada, which enjoys a special place in the gas pipeline network of India, is located in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Kakinada**, which enjoys a special place in the gas pipeline network of India, is located in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The East-West pipeline originates at** Kakinada in Andhra Pradesh and travels 1,460-kilometers up to Bharuch in Gujarat.**
